name: blob
description: Blob frame. Interns a recurring sub-tree by content hash. OPTIONAL, zero or more. Only emitted when the header declared compression='gzip+dedup-2'. See spec/sbtrace-v1.md §6.4.

fields.name: id
fields.description: 64 lowercase hex chars: SHA256(canonical_json(value)). No 'sha256:' prefix in this slot.

fields.name: encoding
fields.description: 'json' for canonical-JSON, 'gzip+base64' for gzipped canonical-JSON in base64.

extension_ranges.description: Reserved for capabilities introducing alternative blob encodings.
Vendor-private. Readers MUST ignore unknown experimental fields when looking up blobs by id.
